178 void MPI_receive_send_guard_cells_down(simu_fields* fields, simu_param* sP, MPI_Comm comm){
179 
180  MPI_Request down_req ;
181  MPI_Status stat;
182  //
183  int down_proc = (sP->mpi_rank-1+sP->mpi_nb_proc)%sP->mpi_nb_proc ;
184  int up_proc = (sP->mpi_rank+1)%sP->mpi_nb_proc ;
185  //
186  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
187  MPI_Irecv(fields->buff_reci_1d, sP->len_buff_field, MPI_FLOAT, up_proc, 1, comm, &down_req) ;
188  MPI_Send( fields->buff_send_1d, sP->len_buff_field, MPI_FLOAT, down_proc, 1, comm) ;
189  MPI_Wait(&down_req, &stat) ;
190  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
191 
192 }
193 void MPI_receive_send_guard_cells_up(simu_fields* fields, simu_param* sP, MPI_Comm comm){
194 
195  MPI_Request up_req ;
196  MPI_Status stat;
197  //
198  int down_proc = (sP->mpi_rank-1+sP->mpi_nb_proc)%sP->mpi_nb_proc ;
199  int up_proc = (sP->mpi_rank+1)%sP->mpi_nb_proc ;
200  //
201  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
202  MPI_Irecv(fields->buff_reci_1d, sP->len_buff_field, MPI_FLOAT, down_proc, 1, comm, &up_req);
203  MPI_Send( fields->buff_send_1d, sP->len_buff_field, MPI_FLOAT, up_proc, 1, comm);
204  MPI_Wait(&up_req, &stat);
205  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
206 
207 }

422 void ohm(simu_B_field* B, simu_fields* fields, simu_grid* grid, int indIt,
423  simu_param* sP_h, simu_param* sP_d, MPI_Comm comm,
424  int ohm_ID){
425 
426  curlB_k <<< 1+nb_nodes_cst/tpb_cst, tpb_cst >>>(B, fields, sP_d) ;
427  if (ohm_ID==0){
428  pressure_k<<< 1+nb_nodes_tot_cst/tpb_cst, tpb_cst >>>(fields, fields->density, sP_d) ;
429  }
430  else {
431  pressure_k<<< 1+nb_nodes_tot_cst/tpb_cst, tpb_cst >>>(fields, fields->density_b, sP_d) ;
432  }
433 
434  #if NB_DIM==2
435  int n_copy_x = (len_y_cst+4) ;
436  int n_copy_y = (len_x_cst+4) ;
437  #elif NB_DIM==3

443  if (sP_h->mpi_nb_proc==1){
444  if (obstacle_cst){

476  // }
477 
478  comm_boundaries_vector_field(fields, fields->E, sP_h, MPI_COMM_WORLD) ;
479 
480  #if inject_pla_cst
481  smooth_field_k<<< 1+10*n_copy_x/tpb_cst, tpb_cst >>>(fields->E[0], fields) ;
482  copy_smooth_k <<< 1+10*n_copy_x/tpb_cst, tpb_cst >>>(fields->E[0], fields) ;

520 void copy_injector(particles* p, simu_tank* tank_h, injector* injec_h, int nb_part_in_slice, simu_param* sP, int idx_it){
521 
522  int idx_part_tank ;
523 
524  if (nb_part_in_slice>injec_size_cst){
525  printf("Buffer too small indeed!\n") ; // Already guarder in load_particle() actually...
526  }
527 
528 
529  #if NB_DIM==2
530  for (int idx_part_inj=0; idx_part_inj<nb_part_in_slice; idx_part_inj++){
531  idx_part_tank = tank_h->idx_ordered[tank_h->indFirstPartSlice[tank_h->idx_x] + idx_part_inj] ;
532  injec_h->rx[idx_part_inj] = p->rx[idx_part_tank] + (len_x_cst-nb_cell_per_shift_cst*(tank_h->idx_x+1))*sP->dX ;
533  injec_h->ry[idx_part_inj] = p->ry[idx_part_tank] ;
534  injec_h->vx[idx_part_inj] = p->vx[idx_part_tank] ;
535  injec_h->vy[idx_part_inj] = p->vy[idx_part_tank] ;
536  injec_h->vz[idx_part_inj] = p->vz[idx_part_tank] ;
537  }
538  for (int i=0; i<2+nb_cell_per_shift_cst; i++){
539  for (int j=0; j<len_y_cst+4; j++){
540  injec_h->B [0][i][j] = tank_h->B [0][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
541  injec_h->B [1][i][j] = tank_h->B [1][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
542  injec_h->B [2][i][j] = tank_h->B [2][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
543  injec_h->E [0][i][j] = tank_h->E [0][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
544  injec_h->E [1][i][j] = tank_h->E [1][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
545  injec_h->E [2][i][j] = tank_h->E [2][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
546  injec_h->Ji[0][i][j] = tank_h->Ji[0][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
547  injec_h->Ji[1][i][j] = tank_h->Ji[1][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
548  injec_h->Ji[2][i][j] = tank_h->Ji[2][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
549  injec_h->density[i][j] = tank_h->density[(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j] ;
550  }
551  }
552  #elif NB_DIM==3
553  for (int idx_part_inj=0; idx_part_inj<nb_part_in_slice; idx_part_inj++){
554  idx_part_tank = tank_h->idx_ordered[tank_h->indFirstPartSlice[tank_h->idx_x] + idx_part_inj] ;
555  injec_h->rx[idx_part_inj] = p->rx[idx_part_tank] + (len_x_cst-nb_cell_per_shift_cst*(tank_h->idx_x+1))*sP->dX ;
556  injec_h->ry[idx_part_inj] = p->ry[idx_part_tank] ;
557  injec_h->rz[idx_part_inj] = p->rz[idx_part_tank] ;
558  injec_h->vx[idx_part_inj] = p->vx[idx_part_tank] ;
559  injec_h->vy[idx_part_inj] = p->vy[idx_part_tank] ;
560  injec_h->vz[idx_part_inj] = p->vz[idx_part_tank] ;
561  }
562  for (int i=0; i<2+nb_cell_per_shift_cst; i++){
563  for (int j=0; j<len_y_cst+4; j++){
564  for (int k=0; k<len_z_cst+4; k++){
565  injec_h->B [0][i][j][k] = tank_h->B [0][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
566  injec_h->B [1][i][j][k] = tank_h->B [1][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
567  injec_h->B [2][i][j][k] = tank_h->B [2][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
568  injec_h->E [0][i][j][k] = tank_h->E [0][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
569  injec_h->E [1][i][j][k] = tank_h->E [1][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
570  injec_h->E [2][i][j][k] = tank_h->E [2][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
571  injec_h->Ji[0][i][j][k] = tank_h->Ji[0][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
572  injec_h->Ji[1][i][j][k] = tank_h->Ji[1][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
573  injec_h->Ji[2][i][j][k] = tank_h->Ji[2][(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
574  injec_h->density[i][j][k] = tank_h->density[(tank_h->idx_x*nb_cell_per_shift_cst)+2+i][j][k] ;
575  }
576  }
577  }
578  #endif

590 void receive_send_part_down(buff_part* b_p, simu_param* sP, house_keeping* h_k, MPI_Comm comm, int idx_it){
591 
592  MPI_Request down_req ;
593  MPI_Status stat ;
594  //
595  int down_proc = (sP->mpi_rank-1+sP->mpi_nb_proc)%sP->mpi_nb_proc ;
596  int up_proc = (sP->mpi_rank+1)%sP->mpi_nb_proc ;
597 
598  // buff_part* buff_part_h = new buff_part ;
599 
600  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
601  // cudaMemcpy(buff_part_h, b_p, sizeof(*buff_part_h), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) ;
602  // int nb_part_send = buff_part_h->next_idx_comm ;
603  int nb_part_send ;
604  int nb_part_rece ;
605  cudaMemcpy(&nb_part_send, &b_p->next_idx_comm, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) ;
606 
607  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
608  MPI_Irecv(&nb_part_rece, 1, MPI_INT, up_proc , 1, comm, &down_req) ;
609  MPI_Send( &nb_part_send, 1, MPI_INT, down_proc, 1, comm) ;
610  MPI_Wait(&down_req, &stat) ;
611  update_nb_part_rece_k<<<1, 1>>>(b_p, nb_part_rece) ;
612  if (idx_it%rate_save_t_cst==0){
613  HK_nb_part_send_down_k<<<1, 1>>>(h_k, nb_part_send, int(idx_it/rate_save_t_cst)) ;
614  cudaDeviceSynchronize() ;
615  }
616 
617  if (nb_part_rece>buff_size_cst){
618  printf("Too many particles to receive down for buffer.\n") ;
619  }
620  if (nb_part_send>buff_size_cst){
621  printf("Too many particles to send down for buffer.\n") ;
622  }
623 
624  if (nb_part_rece>0){
625  #if NB_DIM==2
626  MPI_Irecv(b_p->buff_rece, 6*nb_part_rece, MPI_FLOAT, up_proc, 1, comm, &down_req) ;
627  #elif NB_DIM==3
628  MPI_Irecv(b_p->buff_rece, 7*nb_part_rece, MPI_FLOAT, up_proc, 1, comm, &down_req) ;
629  #endif
630  }
631  if (nb_part_send>0){
632  #if NB_DIM==2
633  MPI_Send( b_p->buff_send, 6*nb_part_send, MPI_FLOAT, down_proc, 1, comm) ;
634  #elif NB_DIM==3
635  MPI_Send( b_p->buff_send, 7*nb_part_send, MPI_FLOAT, down_proc, 1, comm) ;
636  #endif
637  }
638  if (nb_part_rece>0){
639  MPI_Wait(&down_req, &stat) ;
640  }
641 
642  // delete(buff_part_h) ;
643 
644 }
645
